properties.notes: The site comprises a former horticultural nursery containing a permanent horticultural building, a residential dwelling, and a concrete base. The site is split into two, with the southern portion in use, and the northern portion derelict and overgrown. Mature trees and hedges line the western boundary of the site, with Swanley Lane to the east and adjacent residential development to the south.
